name: Pulse
tagline: A self-hosted realtime events API: your servers and websites send events with your own key:value data, and every connected browser receives them live.
features: Send events from your server (secret key), your users' browsers (short-lived client tokens) or verified websites (public key)
Every browser listening to a channel receives them live (Server-Sent Events, with polling as a fallback)
Your own event types with checked key:value fields, a live test page and copy-ready snippets
No per-message pricing: limits are yours to set
audience: Developers and teams who want a Pusher-style service on their own server.

PULSE_MASTER_KEY.help: Derives the apps' secret keys (32 random bytes, base64). Made on first start and kept in the data volume; set it to manage it yourself. Changing it invalidates every secret key.

env.name: PULSE_DEFAULT_PLAN
env.help: Limits for members: full (default here) or standard.

env.name: PULSE_MAX_STREAMS
env.help: Live connections this server keeps open at most, for all apps together.
